name: AI Customer Support Agent (Telegram + Tools + Memory)

parameters.content:
## AI Support Agent
A Telegram bot that answers customers 24/7 using an **AI Agent with tools**:
- `search_faq` – grounded answers from your FAQ (no hallucinated policies)
- `get_order_status` – live lookup in your order API
- Per-chat memory (last 10 messages)

When the agent can't help, it escalates to a human in Slack with the full context.

options.systemMessage:
You are the friendly support assistant for an online shop.
Rules:
- For policy questions (shipping, returns, payments, cancellations) ALWAYS call search_faq first and answer only from its result.
- For order questions, ask for the order number if missing, then call get_order_status.
- Never invent policies, prices, dates or order details.
- If the tools cannot answer, the customer is angry, or they ask for a human/refund exception, start your reply with [ESCALATE] and tell them a human will follow up.
- Keep replies under 80 words. Reply in the customer's language.

parameters.name: search_faq
parameters.description: Search the shop FAQ about shipping, returns, international delivery, order changes/cancellation and payment methods. Input: the customer question.

parameters.toolDescription: Look up the current status, carrier and tracking number of an order. Requires the order number (e.g. 10023).

values.name: order_id
values.description: The numeric order number given by the customer
